description:
Fast, fully offline image description. VisionMate describes the current element, the whole screen, or an image on the clipboard, on your own computer. Images are never sent to the internet.
NVDA+Alt+A: describe the current element
NVDA+Alt+F: describe the whole screen
NVDA+Alt+D: describe the clipboard image
NVDA+Alt+G: automatic descriptions of images without a label, on or off
Press twice for a detailed description in a window.
